paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss steps
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss value over the number of iterations for several language models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1440000, with tick labels incrementing by 20000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is also linear and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels spaced by 0.2. The first line, depicted in magenta, is a solid line starting at approximately 2.5 and approaching 3.4 by the end of the x-axis. A second line, colored orange and representing StrmLLLM (n=64), is a solid line beginning at approximately 2.6 and decreasing to a value near 2.8. The third line, shown in red and representing SepLLM (n=64), is a solid line initially at approximately 2.7 and decreasing to a value around 2.5. The fourth line, depicted in green and representing SepLLM (n=64, H), is a solid line beginning at approximately 2.8 and steadily decreasing to a value of approximately 2.5. The fifth line, colored burgundy, represents SepLLM (n=64, H/T) and is a solid line starting at approximately 2.9 and approaching 2.7. Finally, the sixth line, shown in blue and representing SepLLM (n=128), is a solid line starting at approximately 2.9 and decreasing to a value approximately 2.7.
